listings.title: Huge Double Room in Seven Sisters Station
listings.description:
Double room fitted with a double bed, wardrobe, chest of drawers and desk with a chair. £750 single occupancy /£850 couples 

1 month rent + 1 month deposit 

A bright and fully furnished double room is available in a clean and friendly shared house in Seven Sisters. The room comes with a double bed, wardrobe, chest of drawers and a desk with a chair, making it suitable for someone who works or studies from home. It is warm, comfortable and receives good natural light.

The property is a well-maintained five-bedroom house with a large fully equipped kitchen and dining area. There is one main bathroom shared between four residents, plus one ensuite room in the house. The current household consists of working professionals who keep the environment tidy and respectful, creating a calm and pleasant place to live.

The location is excellent. The house is a 10-minute walk from Seven Sisters Station (Victoria Line and Overground) and Turnpike Lane Station (Piccadilly Line), both offering 24-hour service on weekends. A bus stop is just 2 minutes away with several 24-hour routes including 341, 141, 67, 230 and 43. The area is safe and residential, with supermarkets, off-licences, cafés and restaurants nearby. Wood Green Shopping Centre, with a cinema, Primark and many shops, is only 10 minutes away.

This room is ideal for a professional who values a quiet, clean and well-located home.
